name: Honolulu Hippocampus 2024
information:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png/v1/fit/w_2500,h_1330,al_c/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png)
### The competition weekend in O'ahu continues with an amazing side events competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.

### This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events. If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [Honolulu Hāʻulelau 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HonoluluHaulelau2024), happening on September 21st, the day before.
